name: Cargo Pod
description: A bolt-on pod that adds a few tons of hold. Not pretty, but it pays for itself.

name: Fuel Tank
description: An auxiliary tank plumbed into the main line for longer hauls between ports.

name: Local Chart
description: A hand-inked chart of the lanes near here. It shows systems a few jumps out before you have visited them.

name: Armor Plate
description: Rolled plates bolted over the vulnerable seams of the hull.

name: Shield Booster
description: A compact capacitor that deepens the ship's shield reserve.

name: Fuel Scoop
description: A funnel that sips stray hydrogen from the starlight while you drift, trickling fuel back into the tanks.

name: Cargo Bay Extension
description: A framed extension that opens a whole new bay in the hull.

name: Extended Tank
description: A deep reservoir for pilots who dislike asking where the next pump is.

name: Salvage Tank
description: A patched-together tank from the rim's scrap yards. It leaks a little, but it holds fuel and costs almost nothing.

name: Frontier Cargo Rack
description: Lashed racking in the Free Reach style, built to stack more than the designers intended.

name: Reinforced Plating
description: Thick prospector plating, made for rock and rough landings.

name: Heavy Armor
description: Layered Concord plating, the sort fitted to ships that expect to be shot at.

name: Shield Array
description: A multi-emitter shield grid that wraps the whole hull in a steady lantern glow.

name: Surveyor's Folio
description: A surveyor's own chart folio, inked in a careful hand, with lanes and stray systems nobody else bothered to record. Sold once.

name: House Rack
description: A cargo rack in a lighthouse keeper's own joinery, every slat numbered by hand. It packs tighter than it has any right to: ten tons in five tons of space. Sold once.

name: Cold Hold
description: A sealed, chilled hold that keeps whatever is stowed in it exactly as it was loaded. It holds sixteen tons in eight of space, and the frost on the lid is permanent. Sold once.

name: Keeper's Lens
description: A ground-glass lens that pulls the faint lights of the Dimming into focus, one dark lamp at a time. It charts every settled corner from Reed's Anchor. Sold once.

name: Spark Blaster
description: A plain bolt gun. Quick, light and kind to a small hull.

name: Chatter Cannon
description: A stuttering cannon that trades weight for volume. It chews through shields.

name: Maul Blaster
description: Slow, heavy bolts that hit like a dropped crate.

name: Pivot Turret
description: A gun on a swivel that picks its own targets and aims in any direction.

name: Rocket Rack
description: A rail of tubes for unguided rockets. Buy the rockets separately.

name: Rocket
description: A blunt, unguided rocket. It flies straight and hits hard.

name: Seeker Tube
description: A launch tube with a tracking cradle for seeker missiles.

name: Seeker Missile
description: A missile that turns to follow its target.

name: Lance Beam
description: A beam that hits the instant it fires. Short reach, steady burn. Only the great hubs stock them.

name: Escape Pod
description: A sealed capsule that saves the pilot once if the ship is lost.
